projects.title: Transportation Path Search Capstone
bullets: Constructed graphs from public route tables using Python and NetworkX for a supervised undergraduate capstone on transportation path search.
Tested disconnected graph cases and compared search times on sampled graphs as assigned contributions to the capstone team's work.

research.title: Shortest-Path Query Research Assistance
bullets: Implemented shortest-path queries using Python and NetworkX as a student research assistant working under faculty supervision.
Constructed public transportation graphs from public route tables and compared path search times on sampled graphs.
